answer: Locks are written down in signal, expire in juniper, and fable lists each expiry. The admission bond is time locked for 7 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. Someone running 31 aliases thus needs 76 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 1538 identities would post 2573 proofs and burn roughly 85 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
